git-sync-repo.description: Use this agent for guarded repository sync operations in gzkit. Trigger phrases: 'git sync repo', 'sync changes', 'commit and push', 'sync the repo'. Goal: clean tree, synced branch, and passing gz quality gates.

implementer.description: Implements plan tasks with TDD discipline. Dispatched per-task by the pipeline controller.

narrator.description: Presents evidence for ceremony and documentation sync. Reads implementation and verification outputs.

quality-reviewer.description: Evaluates code architecture, SOLID, test coverage, maintainability. Read-only independent review.

spec-reviewer.description: Verifies implementation matches plan/brief requirements. Read-only independent review.
